settings.heading: Shipping & production
settings.content: Every piece is printed when you order it, usually in 2-5 business days, then shipped. Free US shipping on orders $60+.

settings.heading: Returns
settings.content: Made to order, so we can't take back the wrong size, but if your item arrives misprinted or damaged, we'll replace it. See our returns page for details.

settings.perk_1: Printed to order, just for you
settings.perk_3: Misprint or damage? We replace it
